the epigenetic reprogramming of MIBC cells by a DNA hypomethylating agent.

DAC treatment induces NOTCH1 signaling, which increases IL-6 release and CK5-dependent cell differentiation.
DNA hypomethlation by DAC in MIBC cells activates the NOTCH1 pathway, which induces a senescent-like phenotype and increases IL-6 release.

DAC induces a CK5-dependent differentiation in MIBC cells via NOTCH1/IL-6 signaling.

DAC, at nanomolar concentrations, can activate NOTCH1 signaling, increase IL-6 release and induce differentiation in MIBC cells.
